full_page.content:
Page 103 Cont. October 19 '43 St. Zaw'd
Oct. 7 Irving Lampe - 45 - T.B. in Ford's - seems quite hopeless .....
7 Ray Kollar - 33 - seriously infected foot, laid up now two months.
Page 104
Oct. 8 Mrs. Hattie Duval - 96 - broken hip - until accident a wk. ago, was very
8 John Grebernak -- 333 - two operations find that his arm must come off without delay .... brothers - one a young priest are going to storm Heaven - for him.
Robert Doremus - 15 - quite hard of hearing- both eardrums gone still can hear a little.
Geo. Miller - 44 - serious nerve trouble.
10 Paul John Pilliod - 15 - of Maumee, 0. - birth injury; bright in class but can neither walk, stand, or talk - enrolled Today 5.
Nick Schorn and Well. Queen of Patriarchs
Page 105
Oct. 15 Elizabeth Bryant - 33 - strep poisoning; Twelve weeks in Grace Hosp; 9 transfusions of blook; now two week in Oxigen T. Enrolled To-night .... Fearful pain.
Murld Fortin - 27 - Mysesthenia-gravis, very peculiar ailment - Drs give very little encouragement.
18 Madeline Diebel - 35 - ruptured brain-blood vessel; terrific head- aches ..... Enrolled To-day .... Husband - Dr. D. not Catholic.
Mrs. James Russel1 - 56 - lost husband June 3rd, who had been a ter- rible drunkard .... so that no hospital wanted him .... Finally ... he manifested sorrow for such ... and appreciation for what his wife had done for him and - just brought in some groceries and fell over dead. Priest from St. David's came at once and anointed him.
Joanne M. DuRivaje - 19 - Lakewood (Cleveland Suburb) stricken with spinal maningitis Jan. 26 - was in hospital 29 days unconscious - 2'2 weeks also blind - 2 week more - Now she sees but remains deaf Her mother - 54 - also followed her
